content.summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus comes with 12 replaceable parts. | Photo: Dominic Preston / The Verge Unlike most smartphones, the Fairphone 6 Plus is designed for home repair, with easily replaceable parts that could help extend its lifespan well into the future. That makes its midrange price point easier to justify, especially now that it’s dropped to a new low of $552.49 (about $98 off) at Amazon as part of the retailer’s ongoing Black Friday sale. Fairphone 6 Plus Where to Buy: $649.99 $552.49 at Amazon (black) $649.99 $552.49 at Amazon (green) $649.99 $552.49 at Amazon (blue) The 6.3-inch Fairphone 6 Plus features 12 user-replaceable parts, including the battery, screen, USB-C port, and cameras, all of which you can swap out with the included screwdriver. Replacement parts are relatively affordable, too; a new battery costs $39.99, which helps offset its middling battery life and lack of wireless charging.
